description:
Open and run a hive job in one call: hire solvers through the rails
    (covenant -> escrow -> meter), force reviewer!=author cross-review,
    synthesize only what survives review, settle every escrow exactly-once,
    and return a content-addressed audit hash plus bits-per-joule telemetry.
    Price: $5.00 per solve; model-backed solves have no free tier because
    provider cost must be covered. Sub-hires settle via escrow at each
    solver's list price.

accept_threshold.description: Optional. Minimum review score, 0 to 1, for a contribution to count.
accept_threshold.title: Accept Threshold

budget_minor.description: Total budget for hired solvers in minor units (cents).
budget_minor.title: Budget Minor

covenant_id.description: Optional. A covenant that authorizes the spend.
covenant_id.title: Covenant Id

depth.description: Optional. How many levels of sub-decomposition to allow. Default 0.
depth.title: Depth

fee_bps.description: Optional. Fee in basis points on each escrow. Default 0.
fee_bps.title: Fee Bps

payment_ref.description: Optional. A paid credit or payment reference, used only after the free daily calls. Leave it out to use the free tier or a seat.
payment_ref.title: Payment Ref

problem.description: The problem to solve, in plain words.
problem.title: Problem

redundancy.description: Optional. Solvers hired per subtask, for cross-review. Default 2.
redundancy.title: Redundancy

request_id.description: Optional. Your id for this call. Repeat it to retry safely: the same request_id is never charged twice.
request_id.title: Request Id

seed.description: Optional. Seed for deterministic planning, so a rerun gives the same plan.
seed.title: Seed

subtasks.description: Optional. Your own split of the problem into subtasks.
subtasks.title: Subtasks

name: solve
title: Solve
